name: Automated fire detection and suppression module

source.document: Software Defined Vessel.pdf (resource-governor brief) and supplied Automated Fire Detection and Suppression Module concept image; G4_vtol_rescue_drone_and_hangar.json used as the manifest structure reference only.
assumptions_added: User-defined G6 adopts the optional safety-critical designation proposed in the concept image.
The module is represented as one atomic guest with monitoring and suppression modes; these are modelling choices using existing G4 fields.
Apply Annex A's global demonstration convention of 1 kW electrical demand to 1 kW heat to G6; its cooling type and cooling-loop allocation remain unknown.

capability.description: Monitors simulated compartments for overheating or fires and automatically coordinates the simulated suppression system.

components.name: Automated fire detection and suppression module

configurations.notes: Installation space is required. Location, area and bay allocation are not specified; this entry is an unresolved placement, not an approved configuration.

power_modes.notes: Electrical demand for compartment monitoring and fire detection is unspecified. The governor must not interrupt this safety-critical mode to reclaim resources.
Electrical demand while coordinating suppression is unspecified. The governor must not interrupt this safety-critical mode to reclaim resources.

cooling.notes: Cooling is a required resource in the concept image. Cooling type, conversion factor and load rule are not specified for G6.

operational_modes.notes: Monitors simulated compartments for overheating or fire. Detection criteria and mode-transition logic are not specified in the supplied references.

Coordinates the simulated suppression system in response to detected fire. Activation, stopping and reset logic must be supplied by the simulation/controller; no new trigger parameters are introduced in this manifest.

installation.notes: Installation conditions, crew and duration are not specified.

policy_hints: Exclude G6 from automatic load shedding when resources become scarce because criticality.safety_critical is true.
Mission-priority changes must not override G6's safety-critical protection.
If resources cannot support G6, report the unresolved safety-critical resource deficit rather than silently shedding the module.
Unknown resource values must not be treated as zero or used to claim that admission is feasible.
documented_unknowns: Electrical demand in both modes, cooling demand and compute allocation are unspecified.
Mass, installation footprint, location and installation procedure are unspecified.
Mission-specific capability values, data-link requirements and processing latency are unspecified.
Fire-detection criteria, suppression activation, stopping/reset conditions and event timing are unspecified; no executable trigger is defined.
Operational dependencies and conflicts are unspecified; empty arrays do not establish that no constraints exist.
notes: G6 is a user-defined simulation guest, not an official guest card contained in the supplied vessel presentation.
Only parameter names already present in G4 are used. G4-specific drone loads, flight restrictions and battery events are not applicable to G6.
This file declares a guest manifest. The governor/controller must implement its safety-critical policy and automatic response behavior.
